duration.description: Duration in seconds to run forkstat (0 = run indefinitely)

enable_all_events.description: If true, trace all events (equivalent to -E); overrides 'events'

events.description: List of events to trace; valid values: fork, exec, exit, exitnonzero, core, comm, clone, ptrce, uid, sid, all

extra_info.description: Show extra process info: UID and TTY (-x)

glyph_annotations.description: Enable glyph annotations for easier event identification (-g)

realtime_fifo.description: Run with real-time FIFO scheduling for high-volume event capture (-r)

short_names.description: Show short process name (comm field, not full cmdline) (-s)

stats_only.description: Run quietly and print statistics at end (equivalent to -q); overrides other display options

strip_path.description: Strip directory path from process names (-d)

use_comm_field.description: Use 16-char comm field instead of command line for process names (-c)
